intuitivite.title: Intuitivity
intuitivite.desc: The ideal tool doesn't need a manual. We believe one glance should be enough to understand how to reach your goal. Our priority is finding the perfect balance between clarity and power so technology becomes second nature.

efficacite.title: Efficiency
efficacite.desc: The art of eliminating every unnecessary step between your intention and the result. We don't just develop tools; we design shortcuts to excellence by removing friction to keep only pure performance.

aesthetics.desc: When beauty meets simplicity, technology offers its best. For us, design is not a luxury; it's proof that every detail has been thought through to honor the experience of the user.

how_it_works.subtitle: Three steps to transform your habits into collective victories.

step1.title: Set a daily goal
step1.desc: Common or individual challenge — the commitment is daily and the reward is fun in good company.

step2.desc: Didn't validate your daily challenge? A pre-set penalty feeds the shared pool.

step3.desc: When the pool reaches the target amount, all that's left is to pick a date and celebrate your progress.
